Karnataka Legislative Council Chairman Basavaraj Horatti to Resign

Karnataka Legislative Council Chairman Basavaraj Horatti is reportedly set to resign from his post. This development follows Chief Minister Shivakumar's request for his resignation. The move comes amid the possibility of a no-confidence motion being brought against Horatti.
